student_question: Why do leaves change color in fall?
ai_tutor_response: Leaves change color because chlorophyll breaks down, revealing other pigments like carotenoids (yellow/orange) and anthocyanins (red). This happens when daylight decreases and temperatures drop.
Photosynthesis is when plants make food using sunlight. They take in carbon dioxide and water, and with energy from the sun, they create glucose and release oxygen.

student_question: What is the difference between mitosis and meiosis?
ai_tutor_response: Mitosis creates two identical daughter cells and is used for growth and repair. Meiosis creates four genetically different cells (gametes) and involves two divisions. Mitosis has one division, meiosis has two.

student_question: How does the immune system work?
ai_tutor_response: The immune system protects your body from germs and diseases.
